remaining: Cutters must share the target placement; several cutters accumulate until Enter.
The default build uses OCCT exact curve/face intersections for a BRep cutter; no-default refuses it with a typed error rather than approximating display triangles.
Trim keeps the complement of the picked interval; the pick is a point.
Join orders by endpoint continuity and refuses gaps.
Interactive M03-UI acceptance of the toolbar and point prompts is not performed by the implementer.
